summary: The Legion Warworks are the industrial heart of the Muramite Dominion — a vast complex of foundries, engine yards, armament halls, and planar gateworks. Here, Muramite engineers forge Discord‑powered machinery and weapons used in planar conquest.
history: Warforge Foundry was built to mass‑produce Discord‑forged weapons.
Engine Yards developed machinery capable of stabilizing planar rifts.
Armament Halls became the central distribution hub for Muramite war gear.
Legion Gateworks enabled large‑scale planar invasions, including the assault on Kuua.
The Imperator decreed the Warworks as the Dominion’s primary industrial priority.
